units.source_text: 明石姬觉得机会到了，想道：“若把我父亲做的那个梦告诉他，大概他也会感动吧。”

en.t: The Akashi lady felt that the moment had come and thought, "If I tell him about the dream my father had, perhaps he too will be moved."

units.source_text: 便答道：“父亲寄来的信，笔迹古怪，仿佛是梵文。

en.t: So she replied, "The letter my father sent is written in a strange hand, almost like Sanskrit.

units.source_text: 然而其中也有值得请你看的地方，就请你一读吧。

en.t: Still, there are parts of it that are worth asking you to see, so please read it once.

units.source_text: 昔年我辞家入京之时，以为自今一别，尘缘断绝了。

en.t: When I left home long ago and went up to the capital, I thought that with that farewell all worldly ties had been severed.

units.source_text: 岂知思念之情，仍然遗留在心中！”

en.t: Who could have known that feelings of longing would still remain in my heart!"

units.source_text: 说过之后便嘤嘤啜泣，娇艳动人。

en.t: After saying this, she began to sob softly, her delicate beauty moving him deeply.

units.source_text: 源氏拿过信来一看，说道：“照这信看来，道人身体着实清健，还没有衰老之相呢。

en.t: Genji took the letter and read it, then said, "Judging from this letter, the holy man is truly hale and sound, with no sign of age about him.

units.source_text: 不论笔迹或其他任何方面，都见得特别富有修养。

en.t: Whether in the handwriting or in any other respect, one can see that he is exceptionally cultivated.

units.source_text: 只是对于处世之道，用心未免不足耳。

en.t: It is only in the ways of dealing with the world that his judgment seems somewhat lacking.

units.source_text: 外人都说：‘此人的先祖大臣十分贤明，曾尽忠竭力为朝廷效劳。

en.t: People say, 'This man's minister ancestor was very wise and served the court with the utmost loyalty and effort.

units.source_text: 只因其间行事舛误，应得报应，故子孙不能繁昌。’

en.t: But because some of his actions went astray and brought retribution, his descendants could not prosper.'

units.source_text: 但就女子方面看来，目今尊荣已极，决不是后继无人的。

en.t: Yet seen through the women of the family, their present honor has reached its height, so it is certainly not a line without successors.

units.source_text: 这正是道人多年来勤修佛道的善报吧。”

en.t: This must be the good reward for the holy man's many years of devoted Buddhist practice."

units.source_text: 他挥泪阅读来信，看到了记梦的地方，想道：“人皆责备明石道人，说他言行怪僻，妄自尊大。

en.t: Wiping away tears as he read the letter, he came to the part recording the dream and thought, "Everyone reproaches the Akashi monk, saying that his words and conduct are eccentric and presumptuous.

units.source_text: 我也觉得他当年对我的要求，虽属偶然，实甚唐突。

en.t: I too felt that what he asked of me then, though it arose by chance, was extremely abrupt.

units.source_text: 直到后来小女公子诞生，我方悟得彼此宿缘之深厚。

en.t: Only after the little princess was born did I realize how deep the bond of fate between us was.

units.source_text: 然而对于目前看不到的将来之事，我心始终怀疑。

en.t: Still, about future matters that cannot yet be seen, my heart has always remained doubtful.

units.source_text: 现在读了他的信，方知他凭仗着这个梦，因此强要将女儿嫁我。

en.t: Now that I have read his letter, I understand that he relied on this dream and for that reason insisted on marrying his daughter to me.

units.source_text: 如此说来，我当年横遭冤屈，漂泊天涯，也是为这小女公子一人之故。

en.t: If so, then the injustice I suffered long ago and my wandering at the edge of the world were all for the sake of this one little princess.

units.source_text: 但不知明石道人心中有何祈愿。”

en.t: But I wonder what prayer the Akashi monk held in his heart."

units.source_text: 他颇思一看愿文，便在心中顶礼膜拜，拿起愿文来读。

en.t: He very much wanted to see the prayer text, so he bowed reverently in his heart, picked it up, and read it.

units.source_text: 又对女御说道：“除了这个，我也有东西要给你看，还有话要对你讲。”

en.t: He also said to the consort, "Apart from this, I have something to show you, and there are things I want to tell you."

units.source_text: 乘便又对她说道：“现在你已经明白已往的事情了，然而你不可因此而忽视了紫夫人的深恩。

en.t: Taking the opportunity, he said to her further, "Now you understand what happened in the past, but you must not for that reason make light of Lady Murasaki's deep kindness.

units.source_text: 骨肉之情的亲爱，原是当然的。

en.t: The affection that comes from blood ties is only natural.

units.source_text: 但毫无血统关系的人的爱顾，甚至一句好意的话，却是更可宝贵的。

en.t: But the care of someone with no blood connection at all, even a single kindly word, is far more precious.

units.source_text: 何况她天天看见你的生母在旁服侍你，而对你的爱依旧不变，诚恳周到地照拂你，实在是一个心地善良的人。

en.t: All the more so because she sees your birth mother serving beside you every day, yet her love for you remains unchanged, and she looks after you with sincere and thoughtful care; she truly is a kindhearted person.

units.source_text: 从古以来，世间关于继母有这样的话：‘继母养儿表面亲。’

en.t: Since ancient times, people have had this saying about stepmothers: 'A stepmother's care for a child is affectionate only on the surface.'

units.source_text: 这句话洞察人心，似乎是贤明之言，其实不然。

en.t: This saying seems to pierce the human heart and sound wise, but in fact it is not so.

units.source_text: 即使有的继母对继子真心怀着恶意，但只要继子毫不介意，竭诚地孝顺继母，

en.t: Even if some stepmother truly bears ill will toward her stepchild, as long as the child takes no offense and serves her with wholehearted filial devotion,

units.source_text: 那时继母自会真心感动，幡然悔悟，自念我何故虐待此子，岂不怕获罪于天，于是她的心便改悔了。

en.t: then the stepmother will naturally be moved in her heart, suddenly repent, and think, 'Why have I mistreated this child? Am I not afraid of sinning against Heaven?' In this way her heart will change.

units.source_text: 除了宿世冤家之外，两人即使感情不洽，只要其中一人开诚相待，则对方自然也会改悔。

en.t: Except in the case of enemies from a former life, even if two people are not on good terms, if one of them deals with the other sincerely, the other will naturally change as well.

units.source_text: 此种事例甚多。

en.t: There are many examples of this kind.

units.source_text: 反之，为了区区小事，便强横霸道，指责挑剔，毫无亲善之色，拒人于千里之外，

en.t: Conversely, if over some trivial matter one becomes domineering, harsh, accusatory, and fault-finding, showing no friendliness at all and keeping others at a great distance,

units.source_text: 这便冤仇难解，没有和好的余地了。

en.t: then resentment becomes hard to untangle, and there is no room left for reconciliation.

units.source_text: 我阅人虽然不多，但观察人心种种趣向，觉得性情气度，各有独得之处，每人皆有所长，绝无全不可取的。

en.t: Although I have not known a great many people, when I observe the many inclinations of human hearts, I feel that each person's nature and bearing has its own special merit; everyone has strengths, and no one is utterly without anything worth valuing.

units.source_text: 然而倘要从中找一个终身伴侣，而郑重选择起来，则又觉得难乎其难。

en.t: Yet if one must choose from among them a companion for life, and choose with due seriousness, it seems exceedingly difficult.

units.source_text: 真正心无习癖、性情善良的人，只有紫夫人一人。

en.t: The only person whose heart is truly free of odd habits and whose nature is good is Lady Murasaki alone.

units.source_text: 我觉得这个人真可称为淑女。

en.t: I feel that she alone may truly be called a refined lady.

units.source_text: 但所谓善良，如果过分宽容，变成糊涂，不可信赖，则又不足取了。”

en.t: But as for so-called goodness, if excessive tolerance turns into foolishness and makes a person unreliable, then that too is not worth choosing."

units.source_text: 他一味如此赞誉紫夫人，则对其他诸夫人的评价可想而知了。

en.t: Since he praised Lady Murasaki so unstintingly, one can easily imagine what he thought of the other ladies.
